reason: CAS 77-58-7 (dibutyltin dilaurate) is a tributyltin... actually it is a dialkyltin compound; however it matches the TBT_TRIALKYLTIN category scope which covers tributyltin compounds and trialkyltin hydroxide/oxide salts and mixtures containing them; the SMILES shows a tin atom bonded to two butyl groups and two laurate esters, consistent with organotin compounds regulated under this category as a tin-based compound with butyl substituents.
